tool.name: StrategyQuant
tool.description: StrategyQuant X is desktop software that builds and tests algorithmic strategies without you writing the strategy code. It can export source for platforms including MetaTrader. Licences are lifetime, with an optional 12-month installment.
features: Strategy builder, retester and, on higher editions, robustness tests
Runs on Windows, Mac and Linux
Exports strategy source code for the trading platform you choose
14-day trial. The homepage says no card is required

plans.name: Starter
plans.detail: One-time lifetime licence. Installments were shown at $129 per month for 12 months.

plans.name: Professional
plans.detail: One-time figure shown next to $1,790. Installments were shown as $149 per month for 12 months, next to $175.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.detail: One-time figure shown next to $4,900. Installments were shown as $290 per month for 12 months, next to $420.

tool.pricing_note: Each paid edition showed two figures on the official pricing page on 11 Oct 2026. Installments stop after 12 payments and the licence becomes lifetime. Cancelling early stops the licence. Prices exclude VAT.
